statements.syncPushAckDeleteByObject: DELETE FROM sync_push_ack WHERE object_type = ? AND object_id = ?
statements.syncPushAckTableExists: SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'sync_push_ack' LIMIT 1
statements.syncStateExisting: SELECT content_hash, base_content_hash, sync_dirty FROM sync_object_state WHERE object_type = ? AND object_id = ? LIMIT 1
statements.syncStateNextSeq: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(state_seq), 0) + 1 AS next_state_seq FROM sync_object_state
statements.syncStateUpsert: INSERT OR REPLACE INTO sync_object_state (object_type, object_id, state_seq, current_version_id, content_hash, base_content_hash, last_modified_by_device_id, updated_at, deleted_at, sync_dirty) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
